notes.title: Devlog #13 - UI Polish
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

Time for some fresh UI polish! I’ve been working hard on the full game to make everything feel smoother and nicer, and good news, the demo benefits from all these upgrades too!

    [/tr]

Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] New font and updated overall UI theme
[*] Animated backgrounds for menus
[*] Brand new button designs
[*] Custom seagull cursors
[*] Some settings now have little animations to explain them better
[*] Game tip images are now animated too!
[*] Revamped hunger bar (now it grows bigger when you upgrade it!)
[*] New inventory layout
[*] Fresh stamina bar colors
[*] New thought bubble designs
[*] Added a cool pulsing animation for required item icons
[*] Completely redid all item icons
[*] New container content gauge when you're carrying something
[*] Animated error messages
[*] Fancy loading screen animation
[*] New “Stamina bar increased!” notification
[*] And a new setting to globally adjust the size of the UI
[/list]

I'm super excited to finally share all these tweaks, it’s starting to really come together! Thank you so much for playing and sending feedback, it helps a ton! 💙

Stay tuned, more fun stuff coming soon!

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Activity Randomization
notes.content:
I try to procedurally generate some activities. For instance:

[list]
[*] The character losing their soccer ball: The ball can end up on any rooftop, and the character will be nearby (and outdoors).
[*] Stranded animals needing help: They can appear anywhere along the coast, close to the water (but not directly in it).
[*] Sunbathing characters: They follow the same logic, appearing in various random spots.
[/list]

The locations aren’t predefined, adding replayability, organic behavior, and opportunities for funny situations. [i](Who hasn’t gone sunbathing near a construction site with a screwdriver in hand? 👀)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915507/53b5c12d2b09a2e03f3c1d02b8417889d725624c.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Accessibility: "No Pursuit Mode" and "Infinite Hunger Bar"
notes.content:
Today, I’m happy to highlight two new settings recently added to the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915507/adb0a9d864ffc1f497e0eeb4ce39923c6310794c.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] "[b]No Pursuits Mode[/b]": This feature ensures that citizens won’t seek revenge, no matter what you’ve done to them. I wanted to include this option for players looking for a more relaxed, stress-free adventure or for those who need a temporary reprieve to get through a tricky moment in the game.

[*] "[b]Never Hungry Mode[/b]": With this setting, you’ll have unlimited access to abilities that require food (like dashing or pooping). This is perfect for players who don’t want to deal with managing food resources or prefer not to steal from citizens.
[/list]

Both of these options can be toggled on or off at any time, letting everyone enjoy the game their way, whether for an entire playthrough or just a few moments of carefree fun. 😊

Happy playing!

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Accomplishments Display Overhaul
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Accomplishments are now displayed in a grid layout (instead of a list) for a more compact view, making it easy to get an overview of progress.
[*] Each achievement is now numbered for easier identification.
[*] Different color codes are used to differentiate completed, revealed, and unknown accomplishments.
[*] Hints have been added for each accomplishment (for players who choose to show them).
[*] A confirmation popup appears only the first time a hint is requested, then it won’t display again once confirmed.
[*] In-game notifications now appear faster and at the top of the screen.
[*] The notification widget is more responsive, adjusting its size to try to show the full notification (previously, many notifications required scrolling to view all content).
[*] And of course, the "increase" typo is still there (I noticed it just now while posting this... 😅)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915507/f3282e872fd2121697fe3f5e0ea4ebdab0798875.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #1 - HUD refactor
notes.content:
The Steam Next Fest has come to an end—thank you all for playing the Goeland demo!

I’m now diving back into developing the full game, using your valuable feedback to provide the best experience possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915507/2ae26701afbee00620ea936154bd4936e78331bb.gif[/img]

I'll try to regularly share some updates on development. Today, here’s a look at the ongoing UI overhaul:
[list]
[*] New font
[*] Contextual actions are now displayed under the relevant object
[*] New inventory widget (text is no longer blurry)
[*] Key prompts for possible actions (e.g., “poop,” “dash”) as some players tended to forget them
[/list]
